name: Perplexity
summary: Perplexity is an answer engine that cites the pages it used. A business user can check a fact and open the sources it lists.
paragraphs: Perplexity is an answer engine that cites the pages it used. A business user can check a fact and open the sources it lists.
whyItMatters: Use it when you want an answer with links, and read those links before you rely on the answer.
